scope: Original best, midpoint, and last retained checkpoints on selected new-person holdouts; the full remaining EUR cohort was not evaluated.

method.overlap_ownership: lowest frozen window row per participant canonical target
method.eos: exactly one scored true EOS per participant
method.pooled_ce: summed NLL divided by summed canonical target count

membership: Selected participants are absent from the original training and validation corpus; their recorded family components are absent from original training. Canonical role labels are retained.
sequence_length_definition: BOS + forward-direction token + full diploid content sequence + EOS; no padding or window duplication

source_provenance.controlled_provenance: Exact input/checkpoint bindings, artifact hashes, participant mappings, and validated archive receipts remain in the approved AoU workspace.

limitations: The broader historical canonical holdout partition is not claimed pristine; only the explicitly selected people and stated original-training family exclusions define this evaluation.
Within-family denotes holdout-cohort token CE, not a within-family phenotype effect or PGS attenuation estimate.
No seed-replicated uncertainty intervals, token-frequency/Markov baseline comparison, or downstream trait-prediction claim is established.
The original validation set selected 55K; these holdouts do not select a replacement checkpoint.
Sentence lengths describe full canonical participant streams before overlapping windows; full sentences include exactly three special tokens.
The original frozen allele universe is retained; this evaluation does not assess new alleles outside that support.
disclosure_scope: Reviewed whole-cohort counts, mean token lengths, and loss aggregates only. No participant records, token streams, rare genomic/subgroup details, protected artifact locators, raw logs, vocabulary payloads, or weights.
